3D Leap Land starter test world
Starter scene: https://loxaevion.itch.io/upbge-0361-tutorial-starter-level
Source asset pack: https://essssam.itch.io/3d-leap-land
Original asset pack license: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0).
The starter-page author states the assembled test world is shared with permission from the asset creator.
palette.png is preserved from Essssam's official source pack. The GLB image URI is normalized to palette.png for browser rendering.
This repository preserves both the downloaded FBX and a browser-ready GLB conversion.
